Exp.name: Initialise Zero
Exp.desc: How the initial conditions of the output y are treated

Exp.name: Sampling Method
Exp.desc: Method for resampling time and spatial data

Exp.name: Sampling Period
Exp.desc: Target sampling period for the internal data usage

Exp.name: Spatial Sampling X
Exp.desc: Spatial sampling in the first dimension x

Exp.name: Spatial Sampling Y
Exp.desc: Spatial sampling in the first dimension x

Exp.name: Spatial Sampling Z
Exp.desc: Spatial sampling in the third dimension z (only 3D data)

Exp.name: Pre-Padding
Exp.desc: Number of zero samples that are pre-padded to the input and output.

Dat.name: Data Reduction
Dat.desc: This is the used dimension of the toolkit

Dat.name: 2D Plane
Dat.desc: If the model is reduced from 3D to 2D this is the axis at which the 2D plane will be cut

Dat.name: Cutting Position
Dat.desc: If the model is reduced from 3D to 2D this is the position where the axis will be cut and the 2D plane will be extracted.

Dat.name: Input 1D X
Dat.desc: If the model is reduced to 1D this is the used x position for the input data.

Dat.name: Input 1D Y
Dat.desc: If the model is reduced to 1D this is the used z position for the input data.

Dat.name: Input 1D Z
Dat.desc: If the model is reduced to 1D this is the used y position for the input data.

Dat.name: Output 1D X
Dat.desc: If the model is reduced to 1D this is the used x position for the input data.

Dat.name: Output 1D Y
Dat.desc: If the model is reduced to 1D this is the used z position for the input data.

Dat.name: Output 1D Z
Dat.desc: If the model is reduced to 1D this is the used y position for the input data.

Mdl.name: Numerical Error Bound
Mdl.desc: Numerical error boundary used for convergence

Mdl.name: Numerical Limit
Mdl.desc: Lower numerical boundary

Mdl.name: PDE Solver
Mdl.desc: PDE solver

Mdl.name: Maximum Iteration
Mdl.desc: Maximum number of iterations for solvers

Mdl.name: Number Substeps
Mdl.desc: Number of substeps per solver iteration

Mdl.name: Optimize Free Parameters
Mdl.desc: Automated optimisation of free model parameters

Mdl.name: Maximum Number Modes
Mdl.desc: Constraint for automatically chosing the number of modes.

Mdl.name: Energy Captured
Mdl.desc: Percentag of energy captured through POD modes

Mdl.name: Model Order RC
Mdl.desc: Number of RC pairs used in the Foster model

Mdl.name: Lower Bound
Mdl.desc: Limits the Parameter (Rth, Cth) to be larger than the defined boundary

Mdl.name: Model Order SS
Mdl.desc: Model order of the SS system, i.e. matrix size

Mdl.name: Discretisation SS
Mdl.desc: Modeling approach for the SS system

options.1: Discrete using Ts as sample time

Mdl.name: Noise Modeling
Mdl.desc: Noise modeling including K matrix in the feedback loop

Mdl.name: Solver
Mdl.desc: Solver used to estimate the output of a given state space system

Mdl.name: Solver Init
Mdl.desc: Initial conditions for the solver

Mdl.name: Model Order POD
Mdl.desc: Number of POD modes.

Mdl.name: Mode Selection
Mdl.desc: Method for selecting the number of modes

Mdl.name: POD Protocol
Mdl.desc: Protocol of the POD model (calibration of the reduced matrices C·da/dt = -G·a + α∘q)

options.5: C and G fitted to the training data + α
options.6: C and G fitted with a prior on the projected matrices + α

Mdl.name: Model Order KNN
Mdl.desc: Number of neighbors for KNN

Mdl.name: NSMethod
Mdl.desc: Neighbor-searcher method

Mdl.name: Distance Metric
Mdl.desc: Distance metric used for computing the distance of a new sample with respect to the KNN space

Mdl.name: MinLeafSize
Mdl.desc: Specifies the minimum number of observations per leaf. Increasing MinLeafSize can reduce overfitting by preventing the tree from growing too deep

Mdl.name: MaxNumSplits
Mdl.desc: Limits the maximum number of splits in the tree. This parameter directly controls the depth and complexity of the tree. Lower values reduce the tree size, potentially preventing overfitting

Mdl.name: MinParentSize
Mdl.desc: Sets the minimum number of observations in a node for it to be split. Larger values create simpler trees, as nodes with fewer observations are left unsplit.

Mdl.name: KernelFunction
Mdl.desc: Specifies the kernel function to use

Mdl.name: BoxConstraint
Mdl.desc: Sets the regularization parameter (C) that controls the trade-off between achieving a low training error and a low testing error (generalization). Higher values lead to fewer support vectors but may overfit.

Mdl.name: Epsilon
Mdl.desc: Specifies the epsilon margin in the loss function, which defines a tube within which no penalty is associated with errors.

Mdl.name: MaxEpochs
Mdl.desc: Specifies the maximum number of passes through the entire training dataset. Higher values can lead to better training but also increase the risk of overfitting.

Mdl.name: GradientThreshold
Mdl.desc: Specifies the threshold for gradient clipping to prevent the gradients from exploding. It's useful when training deep networks.

Mdl.name: InitialLearnRate
Mdl.desc: The initial step size for updating the weights. A higher value may speed up learning but can cause instability, while a lower value ensures stable convergence.

Mdl.name: LearnRateDropPeriod
Mdl.desc: Learning rate drop period in epochs: fixed schedule (lrAdapt = 0) every lrDropPr epochs, adaptive (lrAdapt = 1) after lrDropPr epochs without improvement of the validation error

Mdl.name: LearnRateDropFactor
Mdl.desc: Specifies the factor by which the learning rate is reduced. For example, a value of 0.2 means the learning rate is multiplied by 0.2 (i.e., reduced by 80%).

Mdl.name: Adaptive Learning Rate
Mdl.desc: Learning rate schedule

options.0: fixed steps, factor LearnRateDropFactor every LearnRateDropPeriod epochs
options.1: adaptive, factor LearnRateDropFactor after LearnRateDropPeriod epochs without improvement of the validation error (minimum 1e-3 of the initial rate)

Mdl.name: ValidationFrequency
Mdl.desc: Specifies the frequency (in iterations) at which the validation performance is computed. This helps in early stopping and monitoring the progress.

Mdl.name: MiniBatchSize
Mdl.desc: Specifies the number of observations to use in each mini-batch. Smaller sizes can reduce memory usage and allow for more frequent updates.

Mdl.name: Shuffle
Mdl.desc: Specifies how to shuffle the data before each epoch. Options include 'never', 'once', and 'every-epoch'

Mdl.name: Window Length
Mdl.desc: Length of the input window for sequence to point learning. The input dimension of the model is (FxWxNt) where F are the features, W is the window, and Nt are the number of samples.

Mdl.name: Window Strides
Mdl.desc: The strides describe the overab from one window to the next window.

Mdl.name: ValidationPatience
Mdl.desc: Specifies the number of epochs with no improvement on the validation data before training is stopped.

Mdl.name: Loss function
Mdl.desc: Loss function for the optimizer

Mdl.name: Seq2Seq or Seq2Point
Mdl.desc:
Selects if the output nodes should be a squence or single sample:
0) Sequence equal to window length W
x) Positiv integer focus point of the window W (must be smaller or equal to W)

Mdl.name: BasisFunction
Mdl.desc: Explicit basis in the GPR model

Mdl.name: KernelFunction
Mdl.desc: Form of the covariance function, specified as one of the following

Mdl.name: IterationLimit
Mdl.desc: Maximum number of block coordinate descent method ("bcd") iterations.

Mdl.name: Method
Mdl.desc: Ensemble aggregation method

Mdl.name: LearningCycles
Mdl.desc: Number of ensemble learning cycles

Mdl.name: MaxNumSplits
Mdl.desc: Limits the maximum number of splits in the tree. This parameter directly controls the depth and complexity of the tree. Lower values reduce the tree size, potentially preventing overfitting

Mdl.name: IterationLimit
Mdl.desc: Maximum number of training iterations

Mdl.name: NumberLayers
Mdl.desc: Number of fully connected layers in the network.

Mdl.name: NumberNeurons
Mdl.desc: Number of nodes per fully connected layer.

Mdl.name: Activation
Mdl.desc: Activation functions for the fully connected layers of the neural network model

Mdl.name: Thermal Resistance PINN
Mdl.desc: Thermal resistance Rth of the lumped physics model of the PINN (node to reference)

Mdl.name: Thermal Capacitance PINN
Mdl.desc: Thermal capacitance Cth of the lumped physics model of the PINN

Mdl.name: Stator Resistance PINN
Mdl.desc: Stator resistance Rs; available as the constant Rs in the loss equation PvEq

Mdl.name: Data Loss Weight
Mdl.desc: Weight α of the data loss mean(((T̂ - T)/ΔT)²) (ΔT: temperature scale of the training data)

Mdl.name: Physics Loss Weight
Mdl.desc: Weight β of the dimensionless physics residual mean(r²), r = (C·dx/dt + G·x - E·P)/(diag(G)·ΔT); 0 = data only. Typical 0.01 ... 1

Mdl.name: Compute Device
Mdl.desc: Device for training and prediction of the neural networks (DL, PI); the scikit-learn models of the ML mode always run on the CPU

options.1: GPU (CUDA; falls back to the CPU if no GPU is available)

Mdl.name: Parameter Bound Factor
Mdl.desc: Coupled network (SF mode, method 2): every resistance and capacitance is bounded to a factor bnd around its initial value (log-parameters p0 ± ln(bnd)).

Mdl.name: Samples for the Fit
Mdl.desc: Coupled network (SF mode, method 2): the training data are decimated to at most Nmax samples for the output-error fit.

Mdl.name: Loss Source PINN
Mdl.desc: Source of the losses Pv in the physics residual: 0 = equation PvEq, k > 0 = input feature k (W).

Mdl.name: Loss Equation PINN
Mdl.desc: Equation of the losses Pv (W) for PvSrc = 0. Allowed: the input features x1, x2, ..., the predicted temperature T (°C), the constants Rth, Cth, Rs and those of const, numbers, + - * / ** and abs, sqrt, exp, log, sin, cos, tanh, minimum, maximum. Default 3*Rs*x4**2: copper losses of a three-phase stator with the current in feature 4.

Mdl.name: Constants PINN
Mdl.desc: Constants of the loss equations: 'name = value [unit] meaning' separated by semicolons, e.g. 'Rs = 0.0141 [Ohm] stator resistance; k = 0.00393 [1/K] temperature coefficient' (GUI: Physics > Constants)

Mdl.name: Reference Temperature Source PINN
Mdl.desc: Reference (ambient / coolant) temperature of the physics residual: 0 = constant Tref, k > 0 = input feature k (°C).

Mdl.name: Reference Temperature PINN
Mdl.desc: Constant reference temperature for TrefSrc = 0.

Mdl.name: Output Node PINN
Mdl.desc: Output (temperature) whose physics residual is evaluated (1 = first output).

Mdl.name: Physics Model PINN
Mdl.desc: Physics of the residual

options.2: Cauer / nodal network (structure in the GUI view Physics, setup physPI; without it one RC term from Rth, Cth)

Mdl.name: Initial Condition Weight
Mdl.desc: Weight γ of the initial-condition loss: at the start of every profile the prediction stays at the measured initial temperature, weighted with exp(-t/τ_min); 0 = off

Mdl.name: Warm-up Samples PINN
Mdl.desc: Samples at the start of every training window that are excluded from all losses (the recurrent state settles)

Mdl.name: Prediction Mode PINN
Mdl.desc: Prediction of the testing profiles

options.1: whole profile in one pass (state carried from the start)

Mdl.name: Initial State Input PINN
Mdl.desc: Initial state input: the measured temperature rise at the start of a window is an extra input; training: every window (one per stride) gets its own measured start, validation and testing: only the first sample of every profile is measured (windows continue from the prediction). Options

Mdl.name: Collocation Profiles PINN
Mdl.desc: Collocation profiles of the physics loss: only their inputs (losses, ambient) are used, never the measured temperatures; helps most with little labelled data and an accurate physics. Options

Par.name: Data Interpolation
Par.desc: Method used for interpolating data samples

Par.name: Convergence Error
Par.desc: Limit for convergence of numerical optimisations

Par.name: Transient Threshold
Par.desc: Threshold value to separate transient from steady state behavior. If the rate of change is smaller than the threshold (as percent of the maximum rate of change) the signal is assumed to be stationary.

Par.name: Slope Spezific Resistance
Par.desc: Resistance change per 1 K temperature increase
